result.evidence: The lesson contains multiple instances where new text is written directly over old text without clearing it first, resulting in unreadable overlaps. This occurs with formulas, labels, and unit analyses.

issues.description: The new integral formula is written over the previous one, creating an unreadable overlap.
The text 'f(x) = \rho h(x) w(x) [N/m]' overlaps with the previously written 'f(x) = \rho ?'.
The text 'shaded area = total force = 92.46 kN' overlaps with the previously written 'shaded area = tot'.
The unit analysis text '(N/m^3) (m) (m) (m) = N' overlaps with previously written text.
The text 'design for \ge 123.3 kN' overlaps with the adjacent text '+ \rho \cdot \pi \cdot 1 \approx 30.8 kN'.

result.score_reason: The lesson fully meets Level 3 because it contains several major problems (unreadable text overlaps).
